ordering: Matching/duplicate/occupancy previews occur outside BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Authoritative commands resolve idempotency, revalidate current relationships/dependencies, insert one receipt, append owned events/current projections plus required cross-domain participant rows/audit and commit once.

commands.name: CreateSite
steps: normalize name with UNICODE_MATCH_V1 and address with ADDRESS_MATCH_V1; preview duplicate candidates
inside UoW require Customer active/current and recheck duplicate context as informational rather than uniqueness
allocate site_id; insert receipt and Site
invoke LLD-02 DispatchLocationService.create_dedicated_for_site in same UoW using Site name as initial dedicated Dispatch Location name and address_mode=site_derived
insert one-to-one site_dispatch_locations relation and Site created event
audit Site+Dispatch result refs and commit
rules: creation must atomically produce dedicated Dispatch Location relation
address is stored only on Site; Dispatch current address is derived

commands.name: UpdateSiteDescriptive
steps: normalize/preview duplicate candidates outside lock
inside UoW load exact Site and reject ownership change
insert receipt; update accepted current name/address/revision and append descriptive_corrected event
audit prior/new bounded values and commit
rules: linked Dispatch Location current address changes by derivation only, with no copied address write
Dispatch Location name does not automatically change when Site name changes

commands.name: CorrectSiteCustomerOwnership
steps: outside lock preview physical/cross-domain history risk
inside UoW require Site current and new Customer active

prove Site is still pre-operational: only initial Site creation history, no Rooms/Racks/Cloud Deployments/Network Elements/Device resolutions/other registered Site history and all SiteOperationalDependencyValidators CLEAR
insert receipt; update Site.customer_org_id/revision and append customer_ownership_corrected event with exact prior/new
audit/commit
rules: BLOCKED or INDETERMINATE requires a future explicit migration/correction design rather than forced edit

commands.name: ChangeSiteLifecycle
steps: outside lock list blocker summary

inside UoW archive requires no active Rooms/Racks/Cloud Deployments/Network Elements and every registered SiteOperationalDependencyValidator=CLEAR; reactivate requires Customer still usable and no identity conflict
insert receipt; update lifecycle/revision and append event
audit/commit
rules: dedicated Dispatch Location is preserved and not automatically archived/reactivated
linked active Site prevents independent Dispatch archive through LLD-02 dependency validator

commands.name: CreateRoom
steps: normalize name
inside UoW require active Site
insert receipt/Room/created event/audit and commit
commands.rule: Room belongs permanently to selected Site; equal names are permitted candidate ambiguity

commands.name: ChangeRoomLifecycle
steps: inside UoW archive requires no active Racks; reactivate requires Site active
insert receipt/update lifecycle/event/audit/commit
commands.rule: Room never moves Site through lifecycle/edit

name: CreateRack
steps: validate bounds/normalize text
inside UoW require Room and Site active
insert receipt/Rack/created event/audit/commit
rule: Rack Site derives through Room and is never separately selected

name: UpdateRack
steps: validate bounds outside lock
inside UoW load exact Rack; if height changes run RACK_OCCUPANCY_V1 against all current placements to ensure every placement still fits
insert receipt/update current descriptive fields/revision and append descriptive event
audit/commit
rule: Rack cannot move Room/Site via ordinary edit

name: ChangeRackLifecycle
steps: inside UoW archive requires no current Network Element placements; reactivate requires Room/Site active
insert receipt/update/event/audit/commit
rule: archival does not delete placement history

name: SetNetworkElementPlacement
steps: outside lock preview Rack/Site/U occupancy
inside UoW reload Network Element/Rack/Room/current placement; require active compatible Site chain
run RACK_OCCUPANCY_V1 or validate explicit unracked
insert receipt/placement event and replace current projection
audit prior/new placement and commit
rules: placement never changes Network Element Site
placement never changes containment, Cloud, Model, IP or Device Reference resolution
